expected.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.126
expected.title: A complex CM-elliptic Ribet section with infinitely many fibre-torsion points and no proper subgroup-scheme containment
expected.author: Daniel Bertrand; Bas Edixhoven
expected.difficulty_reason: Canonical antisymmetric Poincaré trivialization creates a section above a nonzero Rosati-skew endomorphism. Generalized-Jacobian divisor norms and Weil reciprocity establish torsion specialization, while non-torsion extension classes force the cyclic section multiples to be Zariski dense in the full semiabelian family.

material.preserved_editorial_scope:
\paragraph{Editorial problem boundary.}
Prove only the single complex CM-elliptic Ribet-section construction of Section 2.4 and its consecutive relative counterexample conclusion: for nonzero anti-Rosati endomorphism difference, the canonical section curve is contained in no proper closed subgroup scheme of the Poincaré extension family and has infinitely many fibrewise torsion points. The canonical trivialisation, subgroup argument, and complete independent generalised-Jacobian torsion proof and compatibility in Section 6 are retained. No sharp torsion-order-attainment or higher-dimensional claim is selected.

No enlargement to schemegeneral pairing formula/specialShimura target or sharporder-attainment. Original author signs/formulas unchanged.
material.broader_work_scope: Two distinct new candidates: general abelianscheme exact pairing identity and specialmixedShimura image. Alternate elliptic/analytic torsion proofs and sharpness retained related, not extra independent IDs.
